info.title: Persona Dialogue PMM HTTP API
info.description: PMM HTTP/1 with registry learned-pmm/2.1, learned-pmm/2 and legacy pmm/3 checkpoints. This service computes numeric PMM; API-PMM uses the independently configured LLM provider.

post.description: Stateless computation on the supplied checkpoint. Writes return a candidate. Learned adapter updates must preserve the shared core.
